releaseNotes:
### ⚠️ Existing installs: run this once

`infrastructure/config/config.yaml` is no longer tracked by git. On the server, **do not run a plain `git pull`**: it can abort or delete your live config. From the install directory (e.g. `/opt/cliproxyapi-dashboard`), run once:

```bash
git fetch && git checkout origin/main -- rebuild.sh && ./rebuild.sh
```

After that, `./rebuild.sh` updates the repo and the images safely. The in-app update button only refreshes the dashboard image; the command above also brings the new compose file (persistent plugin volume) and CLIProxyAPI v8.0.29. Details: [docs/INSTALLATION.md#updating](https://github.com/itsmylife44/cliproxyapi-dashboard/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md#updating). 0.1.88 also includes everything from 0.1.87, whose image build failed.
